title: Martina D NDE 5105
content: Even if I was so young when I had the experience I still remember as if it happened yesterday and still feel how it felt during the experience. I remember walking around a lake playing with a wooded stick. My dad was walking nearby with my baby brother who was at the time two years of age. I remember walking towards the water and my father calling out to be careful and not to go closer, of course I was four and curious. I remember playing with the stick and make it splash on the water and then I dropped it. I remember trying to reach for it but I fell in the water. The thing is I didn't try to swim or anything all. I remember is falling and going straight down. The water seemed so heavy at the time. My arms felt heavy. The more I was going down the more it was getting darker but I could still see around me gray water, it's hard to describe. I remember seeing a few fish looking at me and watching me drowning. It was strange because at that time I was thinking it was so cool to fish, so close like that, and looking at me. I clearly remember thinking that I will never forget. Then I saw a small shadow with very long hair like me floating beside me and I was thinking it was so strange. Then everything when black and I saw this strange shadowy path with tiny small shadowy lights floating around with and I still remember feeling like I wanted to laugh. I wasn't walking or floating, it's like someone was carrying me but couldn't see who it was. Then the shadowy lights got bigger. The more I was moving through the path, the more the light got brighter. Then I remember asking myself clearly if I was still under water but wasn't feeling pain of out of breath, all I wanted is to see why it was so bright. That's when I saw and felt a presence reaching for me, no face, no body, just shadowy lines in a form of a 'v' all in white. I'm not sure if it was reaching for me but at that moment, I felt pushed away like I have been sucked out a tube. Then I heard my dad's voice near me saying I would be okay. I opened my eyes and first thing, I asked my father is what kind of fish they have in this lake dad? Because I saw tones of them and they were looking at me strangely. I had no idea that I have been under water for almost five minutes and when they found me, I wasn't breathing anymore. My father saved my life that day and my mother as well; she knew it wasn't the time for me to pass.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A 'strange shadowy path' with small shadowy lights; felt like being carried, later 'pushed away like I have been sucked out a tube.'
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Felt like someone was carrying her; later felt pushed away/sucked out like a tube.

arrival.other_being_detail: A presence described as 'no face, no body, just shadowy lines in a form of a "v" all in white' reaching toward her.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell into a lake and drowned.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Underwater descent/drowning imagery; fish observed; a long-haired shadow beside her; father’s voice heard upon return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Underwater drowning/descent first, then darkness and a shadowy path with lights that grew brighter, then encounter with a white V-shaped presence, then sudden return with father’s voice and awakening.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Observed fish watching her while drowning; saw a small shadow with very long hair floating beside her before darkness; presence appeared as 'shadowy lines in a form of a "v" all in white.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Then everything when black and I saw this strange shadowy path with tiny small shadowy lights floating around…”; “I wasn't walking or floating, it's like someone was carrying me but couldn't see who it was.”; “no face, no body, just shadowy lines in a form of a 'v' all in white.”; “I felt pushed away like I have been sucked out a tube.”
